card.line: Haran was a city in Mesopotamia where Terah's family settled and where Terah died. Abram left it to go to Canaan, and Jacob later went there to stay with Laban.

moments.title: Terah settles and dies
moments.text: Terah took Abram, Sarai, and Lot toward Canaan, but they stopped and settled in Haran. Terah lived 205 years and died there.

moments.title: Abram leaves Haran
moments.text: The LORD told Abram to leave his country and promised to make him a great nation and bless all the families of the earth through him. Abram was seventy-five when he left Haran with Sarai, Lot, and all they had gained there.

moments.title: Jacob flees to Haran
moments.text: Rebekah told Jacob to flee to her brother Laban in Haran because Esau planned to kill him. Jacob set out from Beersheba for Haran.

moments.title: Jacob meets Rachel
moments.text: Jacob met shepherds who said they were from Haran and knew Laban. Then Rachel, Laban's daughter, came with the sheep, and Jacob rolled the stone from the well and watered them.
